q: In Hebrews, faith is the assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what?
quote: Now faith is the assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what we do not see.

q: In Hebrews, without what is it impossible to please God?
quote: And without faith it is impossible to please God

q: In Hebrews' list of faith heroes, who built an ark to save his family?
why: He was warned of things not yet seen.
quote: By faith Noah, when warned about things not yet seen, in godly fear built an ark to save his family.

q: In Hebrews, who obeyed God and went without knowing where he was going?
quote: obeyed and went, without knowing where he was going.

q: In Hebrews, who by faith offered God a better sacrifice than Cain?
quote: By faith Abel offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did.

q: In Hebrews, by faith whose walls fell after seven days of marching?
quote: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, after the people had marched around them for seven days.

q: In Hebrews, who by faith was taken up so that he did not see death?
quote: By faith Enoch was taken up so that he did not see death

q: After the heroes of faith, Hebrews says to fix our eyes on whom?
why: He is the author and perfecter of our faith.
quote: Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith

q: In Hebrews, Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and when?
quote: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

q: In Hebrews, the word of God is sharper than any what?
quote: Sharper than any double-edged sword

q: In Hebrews, God says, “Never will I leave you, never will I…”
quote: Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.

q: In Hebrews, in these last days, through whom has God spoken to us?
quote: But in these last days He has spoken to us by His Son

q: In Hebrews, our high priest was tempted in every way, yet was what?
quote: but we have one who was tempted in every way that we are, yet was without sin.

q: In Hebrews, how should we approach the throne of grace?
why: We will find grace and mercy.
quote: Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence

q: In Hebrews, how is the word of God described?
quote: For the word of God is living and active.

q: In Hebrews, who by faith conceived a child though beyond the proper age?
quote: By faith Sarah, even though she was barren and beyond the proper age, was enabled to conceive a child

q: In Hebrews, how long did Moses' parents hide him by faith?
why: They did not fear the king's edict.
quote: By faith Moses’ parents hid him for three months after his birth

q: In Hebrews, what did grown-up Moses refuse to be called?
quote: By faith Moses, when he was grown, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter.

q: In Hebrews, since we are surrounded by a great cloud of witnesses, how should we run?
quote: and let us run with endurance the race set out for us.

q: In Hebrews, what should believers not neglect?
quote: Let us not neglect meeting together

q: In Hebrews, by showing hospitality, some have entertained whom without knowing?
quote: for by so doing some people have entertained angels without knowing it.

q: In Hebrews, which king of Salem and priest of God blessed Abraham?
why: He is a picture of Christ.
quote: This Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of God Most High.

q: In Hebrews, the Son is the radiance of God's what?
quote: The Son is the radiance of God’s glory

q: In Hebrews, who did not perish because she welcomed the spies in peace?
quote: By faith the prostitute Rahab, because she welcomed the spies in peace, did not perish

q: In Hebrews, when Abraham was tested, whom did he offer on the altar?
quote: By faith Abraham, when he was tested, offered up Isaac on the altar.

q: In Hebrews, by faith we understand the universe was formed by what?
why: Seen things came from the unseen.
quote: By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God’s command
